en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a railway station building with a central pavilion and metal roof, seen from the railway tracks. The station sign reads "FLEN" and other Swedish words are visible on platform signs. Bicycles are parked along the platform, and a few people sit or stand near the station entrance. Overhead electric wires run above the tracks. Text printed at the bottom-left identifies the place as "Flen. Järnvägsstationen." Additional publisher and photographer information is printed at the lower right.
